steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Are you here to deliver meds to Mr. Czerny again?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Sounds rough.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Er, not that he's a bad person or anything, but it certainly would be easier if he remembered to show up for his regular treatments.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Yeah, I wish he'd be a little more mindful of his health.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: But I guess that's what makes him who he is.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I'm gonna get back to work. Want to grab lunch later?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny, I'm coming in.

steps.name: Voice from Inside
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Huh?
Based on past experience, she wouldn't normally get any sort of response, causing her to resort to more drastic measures – such as applying for a spare key card for his room.
But Czerny doesn't seem to be his usual reclusive self today, and the dorm's automatic door slides open almost immediately after his response.
What do you need?
Somewhat suspicious, she steps inside.
Strewn haphazardly across the room are leaves of sheet music, packets of various kinds of instant coffee, tomes related to Arts research, and a frowning Elafia standing in the middle of it all.
An all-too-common sight within Czerny's dorm room.
Most of the time, this scene signifies that he is deep in the creative process, and that nobody may interrupt him.
—In other words, many others from the Medical Department have already made such attempts.
However, the situation seems a little different today. There are no music scores splayed in front of him, nor does he seem to be composing anything.
If anything, this makes her somewhat angry.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny, if you're not busy composing, I do hope you can remember to come to Medical for your check-up.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: We've already made a special exception for you, so please don't take it for granted.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: You came at just the right time, Hibiscus.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Of course I did. After all, you've been like this for more than just a day or two now.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: If I wanted to start a piano class here at Rhodes Island, and take on some students, how would I go about doing that?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Huh? Well, uh, you should go to Logistics and fill out the requisite paperwork?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Wunderbar. Thank you, I'll head over there right now.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Huh? What??

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Umm... What's this on the table...?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: His last medical report?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Wait, Mr. Czerny! You haven't had your check-up yet!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...I had no idea so many people would show up after we announced he would be holding classes.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Excuse me, is this where I sign up for Mr. Czerny's piano class?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Yes. The end of the line is right over here. Please wait a moment.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Goodness, look how long the queue is! I told you to get up earlier, but you just wouldn't listen.

steps.name: Repulsed Child
steps.text: Mom, I don't wanna learn piano!

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: The instructor is very famous in Leithanien. If you miss this opportunity, there won't be a next time!

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: This is your one chance.

steps.name: Repulsed Child
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Ma'am, I've heard that Mr. Czerny can be difficult to get along with. Is there anything I should know ahead of time?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Uhh, I wouldn't worry too much about that.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Since coming to Rhodes Island, he's not nearly as hot-tempered as he was before.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Oh, good to hear.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Stand up straight, be attentive, and make sure you look ready to learn. Be on your best behavior in there.

steps.name: Repulsed Child
steps.text: I know...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Excuse me, is Mr. Czerny well-known even in Victoria?

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Hm? Aren't you his assistant? And you don't even know that much?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry, but I'm his doctor, not his assistant. I'm only here to keep things running smoothly, just in case.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Oh, a doctor? I suppose you don't know much about music then.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: His Morgen und Abend has been making waves even through Victoria's aristocratic circles.

spans.text: has been making waves even through Victoria's aristocratic circles.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Makes sense.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Though, this is quite surprising. As far as I was aware, he only came to Rhodes Island for treatment. I thought I'd be lucky to hear even a single piece from him.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: I'd always heard the maestro was rather eccentric, but I never imagined he'd be willing to start teaching. Would you happen to know why?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I... honestly don't know.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Maybe he wanted a change of pace.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Haha, fair enough. In any case, I'll be the envy of all the housewives once I get back from this trip.

steps.name: Anxious Patient
steps.text: What's wrong, Mr. Czerny?!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Sorry, something urgent came up.

steps.name: Anxious Patient
steps.text: Huh? Please wait a minute!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: (*whispers*) That look on his face...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: My apologies, sir. Please wait here. I'll go check on him.
Hibiscus's initial assumption is that he wasn't feeling well, so she follows closely behind him.
Unexpectedly though, Czerny does not return to his room, but instead makes a turn towards the training room.
Once he arrives inside, he plants his feet in front of a sandbag and starts pounding away at it viciously.
By the looks of things, he has a lot more vigor than she expected.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: That noble, that damn noble, just wouldn't stop buzzing in my ears with his superficial grasp of music.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Does he have any idea how many misconceptions his children have been forced to accept because of his self-righteousness?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Music is nothing like that! How could it be?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: His child's rejection of it is due solely to his own superficiality!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: And the person before him! And the one before that!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Oh, that one wasn't so bad. They only wanted their child to have an appreciation for music...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Hibiscus? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: And here I was, thinking you weren't feeling well.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: It's nothing much. Just venting a little frustration, as you can see.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Even back in Leithanien I used to encounter plenty of nobles like that.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: They'd send their kids to me through Gertrude, hoping I'd be able to turn them into virtuosos.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Of course, I have no objections to teaching, but the majority of them didn't even really care if their children became pianists or not.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: All they really wanted was a private performance from me, or an opportunity to strike up a conversation with Gertrude.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: And even for those that truly wanted their children to become successful, it was only to the extent that musical skills would benefit their status as nobles.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: On top of that, most of the children had already been indoctrinated into being dull or snobbish.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Or both even, a combination that makes my blood boil.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I'm glad you recommended I start exercising. It's proven to be a great outlet.
Czerny points at the sandbag.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Not everyone can be as pure as you.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I know that much.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: In the Afterglow, I had neighbors who wanted me to teach piano to their kids too, just as a hobby.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Or rather, that was true for most people.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But at the very least, they were far more charming than the nobles, which is why I vastly preferred the atmosphere there.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I don't care if people lie to me, but they should at least be honest when it comes to music.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If you don't care for all the nobles who only show up for the prestige, then you probably shouldn't be holding classes.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Medical is also worried about your health–

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Nein, that's not an option.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I need to hold these classes. It is a challenge I must overcome.

spans.text: to hold these classes. It is a challenge I must overcome.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Well, if you really don't want to deal with the guardians, I can go talk to them myself and just ask them to send their kids in.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I can even forbid them from sitting in during the lessons.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That should make things a bit easier on your end.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Oh! That's a wonderful idea.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Let's go with that.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny, it's time for your exam.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny?

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Dr. Hibiscus, are you looking for Mr. Czerny?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That I am.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: I believe he's in class right now.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I thought this wasn't one of the time slots reserved for his lessons?

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Oh, not his piano lessons. From what my kid's told me, he's been attending Hypatia's history lessons lately.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Huh. I'll go take a look.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Uh, hold on, Dr. Hibiscus.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Since you're Mr. Czerny's attending physician, he's more likely to listen to you.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: There are a few things I'd like to discuss.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Well, I can listen, but I can't make any promises.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Excellent. So this is the situation. My daughter told me she isn't able to keep up with the pace of his lessons.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: As a matter of fact, this is a common sentiment I hear among the other parents.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: We can understand his unwillingness to let us into the classroom, but you see, the pace of his class is—

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Oh, far be it from me to suggest the maestro change how he does things, but perhaps he could consider a few small adjustments?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...Are you sure that's what the kids think?

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Well, it's what my child believes, at least.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll bring it up with him.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Good, good. Thank you very much.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Now then, that concludes today's class. Incidentally, this is also my last day as substitute teacher.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hypatia will be back starting tomorrow, so please look forward to it.

steps.name: Students
steps.text: Thank you, Miss Istina!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Thank you, Miss Istina!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What's going on here, Istina?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: That's what I'd like to know.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: A few days ago, Mr. Czerny suddenly showed up for history class.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Hypatia thought he was just fooling around at first, but he actually took the course seriously and even took detailed notes.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The classroom is open to everyone, of course. Anyone can attend if they want.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Alright, thank you.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Mm... So that's how it is.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Whenever a student asks a question, they should be guided towards the answer, rather than corrected outright.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Their immediate understanding is far less important than building the bridge to arrive there.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Excellent. It was well worth attending this class.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Since when were you this studious?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Studious? Nein, I'm here to learn how to teach.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: It has proven to be quite troublesome.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: At first, I expected it to be similar to mentoring Ebenholz and Kreide – not particularly difficult.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: That as long as they could keep up with my playing, as long as they could experience the wonder of performance for themselves, their level would naturally improve—

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But I was wrong.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: The fact is, most people cannot achieve even that much.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...I think that's perfectly normal.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I won't deny that.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But regardless, it has proven an obstacle for me.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: When they ask me question after question, I don't know how to respond.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: They ask things that, by all rights, should never have needed to be asked in the first place.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: To me, the fact that they ask such questions means that their grasp of music is too superficial to even be considered beginners.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Uh, so you're here to learn how to teach?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I now deeply understand how profound the educational process can be!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You... really are enthusiastic about this.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Naturally.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But why?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: What do you mean, 'why?'

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Oh, my apologies, Hibiscus.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I need to head to class. Can the check-up wait until afterwards?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...Sure.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Mr. Czerny's been running his piano classes for quite some time now.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: A lot of our patients have been sending their kids, and some have even signed up themselves. A handful of our colleagues have been attending as well.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It took a while to set in, but he really is crazy influential.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: What's the matter, Hibiscus? You're spacing out.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...I still can't figure out why he suddenly decided to hold these piano lessons.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I mean, when you've reached the very pinnacle of the craft the way he has, it's only natural to want to take on some students, isn't it?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Has he... really reached his peak?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You don't think so?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: His music is already known far and wide.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I've heard that it's even been praised by Leithanien's Twin Empresses.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Moreover, I remember you mentioning that he personally fought the lingering echoes of the Witch King during the Afterglow incident.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: And if he managed to survive even that, where else is there for him to go from there?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: If I were in his shoes, I wouldn't mind starting a class myself – make some money, live a nice, cushy life.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I don't think he's that kind of person.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Then, what kind of person is he?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The kind who'll keep pushing the limits of music until his very last breath.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Do we not make exceptions for that sort of person precisely because of the respect we hold for them?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I suppose so. Otherwise, we would've strapped him to a table in Medical a long time ago.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But right now, someone like him is...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: Thank goodness you're here, Doctor.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Opinionated Patient
steps.text: My daughter told me that Mr. Czerny didn't hold any classes today. Is he struggling with his health?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Please give me a minute. I'll go see what's going on.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny. Mr. Czerny!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Pardon me, I'm coming in.
As soon as Hibiscus throws open the door, waves of sound wash over her. They must've been bouncing about within the room for a long time before she arrived.
Moreover, it isn't Czerny's music. Even an amateur like her can recognize that these sounds are very juvenile.
It must be his students' performance.
Their notes are interlaced with disorder, adding an extra layer of chaos to an already chaotic room.
Hibiscus has always complained about the messiness of the room, but right now, she is far more concerned about the man collapsed in the center.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny!!!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: How did this happen?! All the indicators from your previous check-up were normal—

steps.name: Collapsed Czerny
steps.text: Huh? Urgh... What time is it?

steps.name: Collapsed Czerny
steps.text: Huh? Scheiße, I won't make it in time for my class!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Mr. Czerny?!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Oh, Hibiscus? Sorry, I must've overslept.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Did you come to make sure I'd head to class?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...No, I came to see if you were dead.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Oh. Don't you worry about that. I have no intention of dying until I've brought my students up to a satisfactory level.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What were you doing last night?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Ah. Do you hear the music? The students made it.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I wanted to identify the problem areas, then devise a lesson plan that would better suit their needs.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: *yawns*... I suppose I've been a bit sleep-deprived as of late.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I have a question.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The Czerny I know is a musician brimming with a passion for the arts.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But now, you're suddenly pouring all your energy into teaching.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: To be honest, I'm a little afraid.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Of what?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Of the fact that you're acting like someone who's ready to give up on life.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Like someone who no longer cares about his own future, and simply wants to find a successor.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'm a doctor, and I understand the pain and suffering that come with Oripathy. I'm not asking you to face it with a smile on your face.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: However, you've come here to Rhodes Island. You should at least place your faith in us, and confront this challenge together!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Wait, hold on. You think I've given up on life? Me?

spans.text: Wait, hold on. You think I've given up on life?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Let me get this straight. You think I've lost my will to live, and am desperately trying to find a successor before facing my own death?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...Pretty much, yeah.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Is that really how I come across to you?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: There is one thing I won't deny though.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: When I was performing for the people of the Afterglow, sometimes I got the idea that someday I'd be standing on even grander stages, surrounded by even more people, and stirring their hearts with music.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But when I saw my medical report, it became clear to me that would never happen.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I don't curse my fate. Even if I weren't wracked with Oripathy, I would still inevitably die one day.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But even before that, I'd already experienced the greatest heights a musician could aspire to. I've been luckier than most.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: However, obviously that was not enough for me.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I wanted to go further. I wanted to hear more. I wanted to keep composing.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Which is why I offered these lessons.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In other words, you didn't start this because you lost your will to live, but rather, you see it as a continuation?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: That's not entirely true either.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: It's rather difficult for me to explain it to you cogently.
Czerny is deep in thought for a while. He walks over to the window, and points to a mountain in the distance.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Let's put it this way.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Just as with many other endeavors in this land, music is a distant pinnacle that can never truly be reached.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: My calling is simply to keep climbing that mountain until the end of my life.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But obviously, I cannot.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Even without Oripathy, there would inevitably come a day where I would be forced to descend.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But I do not see that as a tragedy. It's simply accepting fate.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: These children who've received my instruction will traverse the paths I've walked. They will reach the places I've reached, and then they will aspire to even greater heights.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I hope to do this, just as many of my teachers did, and my teacher's teachers before them.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Through the process of teaching, they... No, I, do not think that my life is over. Rather, my life is continuing through music.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Because, while we are descending the mountain with a cane, these children will be happily embarking on their own journey to conquer music–

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Just as we had done.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Just like the sun itself. At any given moment, it is both rising, and setting.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Oh, right. Before I forget, I've actually been working on something the last two days. I'd appreciate it if you could look it over.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What?
As Czerny says this, he pulls out a stack of papers from a messy pile of documents and hands them to Hibiscus.
Hibiscus's eyes are immediately drawn to the header – 'Request for Research Funding - Application Form.'

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What's this...?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: For a Leithanian, and myself especially, the synthesis of music and Arts is second nature.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But this might not be such an easy thing to understand for people from other countries.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I've analyzed this extensively, and feel that it has great potential. So, I've requested research funding for that very purpose.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: So, how's that? That should address some of your concerns, no?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: ...I don't buy it.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You might act like you're brimming with energy, but you haven't been taking care of your health. Just like back then.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If you really care so much about taking on good students, then you should take better care of your own body, for their sake.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: ...I must say, that's the most convincing bit of medical advice I've ever heard.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In any case, hand me those documents.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Now then, you should head to class.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Nein, nein, Hibiscus, that won't do. Can you go tell my students that today's class will be pushed back an hour?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: What are you going to do?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I can't let my students see me like this.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I'll need some time to wash up and take care of my hands.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: *sigh*... Sure, whatever you say.
